concept.title: Securing Your Devices and Connections
concept.shortdesc: Learn how to keep your devices and network connections secure. The topics in this section show you how to protect each one.

conbody.p: Devices and network connections are how everyone at NC State reaches university services, so keeping them secure protects your information as well as the university's.

ul.li: Software updates: how installing updates quickly keeps your devices safe.
Secure wireless network: how to choose a secure network for university work.
VPN: how to securely connect to campus resources even when you're not on campus.
Physical security: how to protect your devices from theft and unauthorized access.
